description: FREE. Read the leads a search_areas job found, up to 100 per page. Accepts the same filters as the Lyre Leads database, passed as filters, e.g. {"relevanceYes": true, "hasVerifiedEmail": true, "noFBPixel": true}. Each lead comes back compact by default: contact details, business email and its verification state, named contact, relevance verdict with its evidence, software and signals, plus a summary and next steps; detail "full" returns every database field. The summary counts every lead in the search (or every lead the filters match), not only the page, so one read answers how many have emails, contacts or no contact yet; read further pages only when the user asks to see more leads. Enrichment keeps landing for a while after the search finishes, so re-read if leads are still enriching.

detail.description: compact (default) or full (every field, much longer)

filters.description: Database filter parameters as key/value pairs, e.g. {"relevanceYes": true, "minReviews": 100}

name: get_search_results
title: Read a search's leads
